recentItems.title: Shilpa Shetty’s Ganpati Visarjan DANCE Becomes Meme Material, Actress REACTS
recentItems.description:
Shilpa Shetty responded with a witty reply after an influencer teased her energetic Ganpati Visarjan dance. The actress celebrated the festival with her family and later visited Lalbaugcha Raja As always, Shilpa Shetty celebrated Ganesh Chaturthi with fervour. During the visarjan, the actress danced to the beats of the dhol as the paparazzi cheerfully captured videos of her festive spirit. While the videos made the rounds on social media and drew praise from netizens, an influencer poked fun at her dance, and Shilpa replied with a witty, befitting comeback. Shilpa Shetty and her husband Raj Kundra bid adieu to Lord Ganesha during the Ganpati Visarjan celebrations. Watch the video.

recentItems.title: Viral Video: Salman Khan’s Sweet Gesture For Paps At Ahaan Panday’s Ganpati Wins Hearts
recentItems.description:
Salman Khan made a stylish appearance at actor Ahaan Panday’s residence, as Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations continued across Mumbai. The superstar was spotted arriving at Ahaan Panday’s home in a casual yet striking all-black look. Salman wore a black T-shirt with matching trousers and completed his outfit with a black hat. As soon as he arrived, paparazzi waiting outside quickly surrounded the superstar and captured his entry on camera.
